title: The Demand in the Ledger
eyebrow: Design for approval · The Ophan's demand (#419) · drawing and clean pages built, the rest not yet

short.lead: The ledger in the Lair already shows the demanded piece as an ink-and-wash drawing across the whole left page, and both pages sit on clean vellum. You have since decided that the book shows nothing but that picture and the words "The Ophan demands", glowing white, amber or red as the demand nears, and that the picture can be ripped out and carried into the raid. Five choices are still open; every change is then built in one go.
short.hint: Tap a step to see what it creates and what it needs from you.
items: The piece drawn across the left page

Built and pushed on 2026-10-27: a hidden camera photographs the piece's own model once, and the photo is turned into ink outline, hatching and a brown wash. Any piece can be demanded without drawn art.
Both pages on one clean sheet
Built and pushed on 2026-10-27, after you said the right page looked broken: the book's ruled columns no longer cut through anything.
You choose the five open answers
The choices below, and this page's decisions written into the project's decisions log.
Your picks, sent with "Design approved: demand page".
Only "The Ophan demands", glowing by urgency
The right page loses the item's name, the last raid and the purses. The words glow faint white with 3 raids left, amber with 2 and red when the demand is due this raid.
Your picks on how the ink glows and where the purses go.
The drawing can be ripped out and carried
A player tears the left page out in the Lair, carries it into the raid and raises it to look at mid-raid.
Your picks on who carries it, how it is looked at, and what happens when it is lost.

choices: glow
How does the ink glow?
A
A soft halo that breathes, faster when it is due
The halo swells and fades every two to five seconds; red breathes about twice as fast.
B
A steady halo
The same colours, no movement.
C
A breathing halo that also lights the table
A small coloured light above the page tints the table and the book.
Movement draws the eye across a dark room, and a faster red feels urgent without a number.
purses
The purses and the last raid leave the book. Where do they go?
A
Nowhere for now
The demand work (#419) already removes the debt and the Collector; the purses are decided with it.
B
Onto each wizard's strongbox lid
Each player reads their own coins on their own box.
C
On the next spread of the ledger
Look at the book and press E to turn to a plain page of accounts.
It keeps this change to the demand page alone, as you asked.
tear
Who tears the page out, and how many are there?
A
One page for the company; whoever tears it carries it
Look at the book and press E. The book shows a torn stub until you come home.
B
Every player tears their own copy
The book draws a fresh page each time one is torn.
One page makes it something to protect and pass along, which suits a game about carrying things out alive.
view
How is the page looked at during a raid?
A
Hold a key to raise it in front of your view, still walking
Like holding up a map: it covers part of the screen, and you can keep moving.
B
A key opens it full screen and you stop
Easier to read, but you stand still while looking.
C
It is a carried object you hold in your hands
It takes the hand that would carry loot.
It stays in the world, never a menu, and costs a little attention rather than a stop.
lost
What happens when the carrier dies or drops it?
A
It falls where they fall, and anyone can pick it up
If nobody does, the ledger draws it again when the company comes home.
B
It is lost until the next demand
The company goes on from memory alone.
A loss with a way back: the drawing matters, but losing it never locks the company out of a demand.

wrapup.summary: The rest of the demand page's design: the book shows only the drawing and "The Ophan demands", glowing by urgency, and the drawing can be torn out and carried into a raid.
wrapup.changing: The right page loses everything but the glowing words; a torn-out page becomes something you carry and raise to look at.
wrapup.blocking: Your five picks. Nothing more is built until then, and then every change is built together.
wrapup.next: On approval I log the decisions, build everything on the same branch, and send in-game pictures of the three glow colours and the torn page, plus a two-player check.
